Internal helper: the lines of a short style file

Source: R/tables.R
dot-jst_style_short_lines.Rd

What jstyle(save.as =) writes when it is given settings (Session 406; Jeff, Session 402: "if only the changes are listed, then it writes only the changes with the 'based on' providing all other specs"): a header saying so, the two stamps, based.on naming the style copied, then the settings given – the general ones first, then each section's under its heading – each after the note on what it does and what it takes. The header is the file's name on a line of its own, then one sentence a line, none wrapped (Session 407; Jeff: "each sentence should be on its own line ... Notepad and other text editors should easily be able to handle sentences that are relatively long without wrapping"). A blank line follows each setting, none between a setting's notes and the setting (Session 410; .jst_style_blank_lines()).

Usage

.jst_style_short_lines(name, based, vals)

Arguments

name

The new file's style name.

based

The style copied: its name, or its path when it was given by path.

vals

The settings (.jst_style_given()).
